name: qfd_n59_qbank12b-qb12b-COMMIT
purpose: QKO-N59 qbank12b (10-21): structural successor of qbank11a (route.a2 pve1: GRT overflow 0, but CTS TT setup -400 ps reg->macro p_dd[244] -> writer4 wd_in[283]: one p_dd bit drove the 17 replicated wd pins along the 160-um macro face, ~920 ps buffer daisy chain). Fix QB_WLOCAL=1 (0 edges, bit-exact): per writer a kept relay stage w1 (== f_*) + macro-local kept stage w2 (4 data copies <= 6 pins each, 16 one-hot mask flops x32 pins, 5 addr, ce with the p_* reset) drive every write pin. Outline 993.6 x 475.2 (qbank11b geometry, 124.6-um central channel). MAIN (12a) + FALLBACK (12b) in parallel. Submission metadata repaired in isolated Codex worktree; actual gate uses immutable content snapshot fc2b092be4969c33c4fae82efe1fd4ecaf1713e188878486dab9ae2aa6a11a87 (provenance source 47c14228d, including exact frozen daemon overlays). Hardware source, geometry, clock/data edges and gate-consumed spec stay unchanged. Final verdict and critical PNG review remain required.
